currency.description: Currency code in which the price is specified.

shop.description: Identifier or name of the shop offering the product.

items.description: Products retrieved for the current page.

count.description: Number of products returned in the current page.

maxPageSize.description: The most rows one page can hold.

pageSizeCapped.description: Indicates whether the requested page size exceeded the server maximum and was capped.

query.description: Search term applied to filter the products, or null if omitted.

nextPageToken.description: Cursor token used to fetch the subsequent page of products, or null if none remain.

description: Paginated list of products matching the request parameters.
